_comment: Single source of truth: every model and reasoning-effort level the router (JEV, or the local mock) may choose, per provider - all verified live on 2026-09-24. 'models' with selectable=true are offered to JEV as the 'model' question; each model's 'levels' are what it really supports. policy.excluded_efforts is removed from EVERY provider in code (core.py), never offered to JEV and stripped from any answer. Agents/roles that enforce a (model, effort) pair are generated from this file by `python router/skills_hub.py agents --apply`.

policy.note: 'ultra' (Codex: 'maximum reasoning with automatic task delegation', i.e. ultra/auto-delegation mode) is never selectable - not by JEV, not by the local mock, not via override. Stripped in core.py regardless of what an answer says.

claude.policy: Always the family's generic Claude Code alias (sonnet/opus/fable), never a pinned/dated model ID; the alias always points at the family's latest version. Haiku can never be selected, not even via an override tag.
claude.verified: 2026-09-24: `claude --help` (--effort low|medium|high|xhigh|max; --model aliases fable/opus/sonnet) + live `claude -p --model <fable|sonnet|opus> --effort <low|max>` runs, all OK. Claude Code 2.1.281.

models.description: Claude Fable - fastest and cheapest Claude family; simple, well-scoped tasks, formatting, short answers
Claude Sonnet - balanced Claude family; everyday coding, writing, analysis, tests
Claude Opus - strongest Claude family; hard reasoning, proofs, architecture, large refactors

codex.verified: 2026-09-24: `codex debug models` (live catalog, CLI 0.156.1). NOTE: ~/.codex/models_cache.json was stale (written by the ChatGPT app's bundled 0.155.0 client) and missed gpt-6-astra / gpt-6-sol / gpt-5.6-sol - always refresh from `codex debug models` (router/probe_models.py).

models.description: GPT-6-Astra - frontier intelligence for the most demanding work
GPT-6-Sol - workhorse model for coding and everyday work (Codex default)
GPT-6-Luna - fast and affordable model for easier tasks
GPT-5.6-Sol - older coding model for complex work
GPT-5.6-Terra - older balanced model for straightforward work
GPT-5.6-Luna - older fast and efficient model
GPT-5.5 - legacy coding model
hidden in the catalog (visibility=hide)
hidden; defensive-cybersecurity specialist - not a general routing target
hidden; cyber-permissive variant for authorized security research only - never routed to automatically
hidden; Codex's automatic approval-review model, not a general-purpose model

codex.role_name_rule: Codex agent roles are named <model>-<effort> with '.' replaced by '_' (TOML-safe), e.g. gpt-5_6-sol-high.
codex.hook_trust: Codex runs a new/changed hook only after it is trusted once: run `codex` (interactive) -> /hooks -> trust. Until then `codex exec` skips it silently (verified 2026-09-23).
codex.agents_note: Roles: [agents.<name>] in ~/.codex/config.toml with description + config_file (role TOML: model, model_reasoning_effort, developer_instructions). Verified: Codex lists the generated roles as spawnable agent types.

antigravity.verified: 2026-09-24: `agy models` (CLI 1.2.9, logged in). The effort is part of the model slug (…-low/-medium/-high); models without a suffix have a single fixed setting.

models.description: Gemini 3.8 Flash - newest fast Gemini; everyday tasks
Gemini 3.7 Flash - previous fast Gemini
Gemini 3.6 Flash - older fast Gemini
Gemini 3.1 Pro - strongest Gemini; hard reasoning, long context
Claude Sonnet 4.6 (Thinking) inside Antigravity
Claude Opus 4.6 (Thinking) inside Antigravity - strongest non-Gemini option
GPT-OSS 120B (Medium) - open-weight model

antigravity.cli_home_note: Antigravity CLI uses ~/.gemini/ (its own subfolder ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/); global config in ~/.gemini/config/.

hook.contract: Fires before EVERY model call of a turn; stdin has no prompt text (conversationId, transcriptPath, invocationNum, ...); stdout {"injectSteps": [{"ephemeralMessage": ...}]}.
hook.transcript_format: VERIFIED 2026-09-23: transcriptPath = ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/brain/<conversationId>/.system_generated/logs/transcript.jsonl; the user turn is type=USER_INPUT with content '<USER_REQUEST>...</USER_REQUEST><ADDITIONAL_METADATA>...'; already written when PreInvocation fires.
hook.windows_quoting: VERIFIED: hook commands run via `cmd /c`, which breaks quoted paths with spaces - hooks call the space-free shim ~/.jev-router/bin/run_hook.py.
hook.trust: No trust gate: the hook ran on the first real call.

skills.mechanism: ~/.gemini/config/skills.json 'entries' list, each path scanned one level deep.
skills.path_rule: VERIFIED 2026-09-23 (agy 1.2.9): entry paths must be ABSOLUTE ('~/.skills' is rejected at runtime despite the docs) - use C:/Users/<user>/.skills.
